meta.title: DeepSeek UI
meta.description: Turns DeepSeek Harness into the DeepSeek app: official artwork and palette, a time-grouped sidebar, a system settings window with wallet balance and Usage/Top-up actions, the collapsed window-chrome pill, and a chat-demo conversation and composer. Sessions, panels, shortcuts, and account data stay on the shipped implementations.
